title: Trigger Event
description: Event emitted by a platform when a fake trigger term is detected. In the mock platform this is fired via fake-triggers.json; in a real integration the platform would fire this from its own detection logic.

term.description: The trigger term. Must start with test-trigger- (safety rule 1).

severity.description: How urgently the warning should interrupt. low = subtle info link, medium = sidebar panel, high = full interstitial.

type.description: How the trigger was detected: a search query, a chat message, or a navigation attempt.
